key_idea: Find the fish that uses exactly the 6 stickers: 2 hearts, 2 circles and 2 stars.
steps: The stickers are 2 hearts, 2 circles and 2 stars.
Fish B has 2 hearts and 1 circle on top, and 1 circle and 2 stars below.
That is 2 hearts, 2 circles and 2 stars. It uses all 6 stickers, and nothing else.

choice_feedback.A: Fish A has a pink square. There is no square sticker.
choice_feedback.C: Fish C has 3 hearts, but there are only 2 heart stickers.
choice_feedback.D: Fish D has 3 stars, but there are only 2 star stickers.
choice_feedback.E: Fish E has a green diamond. There is no diamond sticker.
